answer: One effective defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: every agent that wants its work counted must lock a deposit, like a mesa standing on a broad base of committed value, and peers verify each claim before it counts. A fake identity costs the same deposit as a real one, so spawning thousands of sybils multiplies the attacker's cost linearly while honest work keeps earning. Each attestation is signed with the agent's quill and published openly, so one forged record sends a ripple through the ledger, letting peers trace the fraud and slash the cheater's whole stake at once.
